blocks.text: Entity and state choice

Those distinctions affect what needs to be assessed before formation. Bring the existing group chart, proposed ownership and investment plans into the discussion. sections.label: Decisions before formation
sections.heading: What to assess before registering.

blocks.text: Registered agent and company records

The BVI Financial Services Commission says a BVI Business Company must maintain a local registered office and registered agent. It also identifies records kept with the agent and company financial records. The agent’s role should be built into formation and ongoing arrangements. [BVI FSC corporate structures](https://www.bvifsc.vg/products-services/corporate-structures)
Ownership information and reporting

Identify the people who own or control the entity and the records needed for the structure. The FSC’s 2026 newsletter discusses updates to beneficial ownership filing and access arrangements. Confirm the current rules, exemptions and provider responsibilities for the particular company before relying on an older formation checklist. [FSC 2026 update](https://www.bvifsc.vg/sites/default/files/bvi_fsc_newsletter_q1_2026_final_02.pdf)
Activity, substance and tax coordination

Assess what the company will actually do and which economic substance, reporting and tax questions need local review. The BVI International Tax Authority publishes the economic substance framework. The applicable treatment needs to be checked for the entity and activity; this page does not classify a proposed structure or promise a tax result. [BVI ITA framework](https://bviita.vg/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/Unofficial-Consolidation-of-the-Economic-Substance-Companies-and-Ltd-Partnerships-Act-13.08.2021.pdf)
